items.title: A deleted fixture leaves no kept pass of its reader current, so the lanes run the reader again

steps.title: A deleted fixture leaves no kept pass of its reader current, so the lanes run the reader again
steps.rationale:
Note: SQA-415 (P2), reopened by the review at 8eb8703de and checked by the lead against cmd/validate/lane_reach.go and internal/landing (CycleLanesReached) at efa59bd59: valid from source, a check that passes without checking, in the lanes the owner's review of 2026-11-25 asked to be reliable. stillCurrent judges a kept pass current when no path changed since it reaches its test. A deleted fixture is no tracked document, so documentReaders finds no reader for it and discover returns no reach: a reader's pass stays current, and -reached skips the test that would now fail on the missing file (fixtures/needle_upstream_calls.json for needle-reference, fixtures/moss/checkpoint.json for the models lane). Deleting a fixture is ordinary work on the repository, so the lanes runner meets it on the row that does it. The change: a changed path stillCurrent cannot resolve to a reader, a deleted document among them, makes no kept pass current in the lanes that read documents, which run again. First read discover and documentReaders, and which lanes read documents.

Check: TestADeletedFixtureRunsItsReaderAgain, a kept pass whose reader reads a fixture deleted since: the pass is not current.

decisions.question: skill.md's 227 rule lines each cite a check. Read at 3ba4de8c7: the first check of 181 has a doc comment and of 45 has none, and the comments state what their test holds, not the rule that cites it ("purpose = recursive self-improvement ..." cites TestCycleFilesDeclinesAndAcceptsNothing, whose comment is the cycle's comparisons; "scorecard columns = ..." cites TestScorecardRowsEveryServableModel, whose comment is rows and dashes). Writing skill.md from the comments as they stand changes what it says. Which form does skill.md take?
options: Each rule line moves onto its first check as a doc-comment line of its own, and skill.md is generated from those lines and its judgement section, so it says what it says now, each rule written once on its check
skill.md holds its terms and judgement lines alone; the rule lines go, each check saying its rule when it refuses
skill.md is written from the tests' doc comments as they stand, its wording changing to theirs
decisions.recommendation: Each rule line moves onto its first check as a doc-comment line of its own, and skill.md is generated from those lines and its judgement section, so it says what it says now, each rule written once on its check
